historical_implementation.rng: std::mt19937 seeded from time(nullptr), with modulo decisions and run-member selection
historical_implementation.p0_defect: the boundary logical row could close a run without attaching it to a previous row, leaving multiple disconnected components
contract_breaks: the first logical row was not a continuous corridor
allocation and blocked-cell insertion failures were not reported

correction.policy: The legacy ABI symbol adopted the corrected boundary-row corridor in this already-landed hardening change.
correction.boundary_row: force every non-edge sweep carve on the first logical row
correction.later_rows: each closed run opens exactly one connection to the previous logical row
correction.rng: shared Maze PCG32 generation context using bounded draws
correction.legacy_compatibility: Do not restore disconnected historical rasters. Keep maze_make_sidewinder as an ABI 1.x adapter to the corrected algorithm.

requirements: all odd/odd logical cells are passages
edge count equals logical node count minus one
every raster cell between the first and last logical cell of the boundary row is open

sweep_contract.coordinate_system: local x increases east and local y increases south
sweep_contract.EAST_NORTH: rows advance south from y=1 and each run advances east
sweep_contract.EAST_SOUTH: rows advance north from y=height-2 and each run advances east
sweep_contract.WEST_NORTH: rows advance south from y=1 and each run advances west
sweep_contract.WEST_SOUTH: rows advance north from y=height-2 and each run advances west
sweep_contract.metamorphic_oracle: for the same seed, horizontal and vertical raster reflections map EAST_NORTH to the other three sweeps
